evidence: Arithmetic on observed histories. min(mean demand, supply) is at least mean min(demand, supply); the recorded gap includes all demand variability within each 16.57-hour gathering block. It does not isolate stochastic variability from temporal evolution and supplies no feedback-corrected size distribution.
reading_rule: Allocation gaps have units kg/m2/h, numerically mm/h of liquid-water equivalent. They retain four separate gathering blocks, then sum over layers. Mean-CDF quantiles are brackets on the native query grid; they differ from means of individual realization quantiles and are not confidence intervals.
